name: Solace Reconfigure Mid Boot
description:
A mid-height boot with a thermally activated sole that reshapes itself to the wearer's foot geometry after a brief heat cycle from a pocket-sized activator tool. Originally developed for prosthetics rehabilitation clinics, it crossed over into consumer markets when augmented users realized how well it handled transition periods — when chrome is being upgraded, swapped, or repaired and foot geometry changes frequently. The upper is a soft matte nylon with minimal seaming and a side zip.

Favored by Tier 3 augmented users who cycle through prosthetic configurations, or anyone whose augmentation is still being calibrated. The boot conforms once per heat cycle and holds its shape until reset.
functionality: Thermally activated sole reshapes to exact foot geometry using included heat-activator tool. Holds custom shape until reset. Accommodates changing prosthetic configurations.
what_it_says: You're in transition — upgrading, adapting, figuring it out. Or you're just thorough about fit.
worn_by: augmented users cycling through prosthetic upgrades
Tier 3 chrome users during calibration periods
story_hooks: The boot's sole retains the ghost impression of every previous geometry it's been molded to — a worn pair is a history of someone's prosthetic changes.
Solace boots are stocked in several corporate medical facilities, meaning a pair can get you into waiting rooms and corridors where street clothes wouldn't.
